name: Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle
summary: The Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle was the first motorized vehicle driven on the Moon.
hook: I was the first rover driven on the Moon and traveled over 27 kilometers across Hadley Rille.
how_it_worked: Powered by non-rechargeable silver-zinc batteries and four electric wheel motors with wire-mesh tires.
science: Allowed astronauts to travel far from the lander and retrieve the 4-billion-year-old Genesis Rock.

facts.text: The rover was parked about 160 meters from the Lunar Module so its camera could film liftoff.
Its tires were made of woven zinc-coated piano wire with titanium chevrons for grip.

image.alt: Astronaut James Irwin works at the Lunar Roving Vehicle at Hadley-Apennine, with Mount Hadley behind
